title: Vowels and the phonotactic clustering of German Dialects / manually corrected PAD alignment layer
why_promising: A new annotation layer over historical PAD recordings: dialect and Standard German orthographic transcriptions are used to create WebMAUS TextGrids, which are then manually corrected and combined into CSV. The public project description reports 25 aligned recordings in the working dataset and documents an explicit manual-correction stage.
open_question: Locate a stable public deposit or downloadable corrected TextGrid/CSV release, establish file-level license and provenance, and isolate the new corrected alignment layer from the pre-existing PAD recordings. Do not count historical PAD audio as new primary recordings.
